subject: history
title: Revolutions in India (Agriculture & Allied)
description: All 16 agricultural revolutions — Green, White, Blue, Pink, Golden, Silver, Round, Rainbow and more

content.overview: India has seen several 'revolutions' in agriculture and allied sectors. These are frequently asked in UPSC/PSC exams.
keyPoints: Green Revolution: Food grains (wheat & rice) — M.S. Swaminathan, 1960s-70s, Punjab/Haryana/Western UP
Pink Revolution: Onion / Pharmaceuticals / Prawn production
White Revolution: Milk — Operation Flood by Verghese Kurien (1970s), Amul model
Evergreen Revolution: Overall agriculture development (sustainable, without ecological harm — coined by M.S. Swaminathan)
Rainbow Revolution: Integrated development — Agriculture + Horticulture + Forestry + Sugarcane + Fishery + Poultry + Animal Husbandry

mnemonics.trick: Black-Petroleum, Blue-Fish, Brown-Leather/Cocoa, Golden Fibre-Jute, Golden-Fruits/Honey, Green-Food grains, Grey-Fertilizer, Pink-Onion/Pharma/Prawn, Red-Meat/Tomato, Round-Potato, Fibre-Cotton, Silver-Egg/Poultry, White-Milk, Yellow-Oilseeds, Evergreen-Overall Agri, Rainbow-Integrated Agri
mnemonics.explanation: Match each colour to its sector: Black=Petroleum, Blue=Fish, Brown=Leather/Cocoa, Golden Fibre=Jute, Golden=Fruits/Honey, Green=Food grains, Grey=Fertilizer, Pink=Onion/Pharma/Prawn, Red=Meat/Tomato, Round=Potato, Fibre=Cotton, Silver=Eggs, White=Milk, Yellow=Oilseeds

mnemonics.trick: Green = M.S. Swaminathan | White = Verghese Kurien (Operation Flood) | Blue = Hiralal Chaudhuri & Arun Krishnan
mnemonics.explanation: Green Revolution — M.S. Swaminathan; White Revolution — Verghese Kurien (Operation Flood, Amul); Blue Revolution — Hiralal Chaudhuri & Arun Krishnan

mnemonics.trick: Golden vs Golden Fibre = Fruits/Honey vs Jute | Red vs Pink = Meat/Tomato vs Onion/Prawn | Round = Potato (potatoes are round!)
mnemonics.explanation: Golden = Fruits/Honey, Golden Fibre = Jute; Red = Meat/Tomato, Pink = Onion/Pharma/Prawn; Round = Potato (easy to remember — potatoes are round)

quiz.question: Green Revolution is associated with:
quiz.explanation: Green Revolution (1960s) is associated with food grains — led by M.S. Swaminathan

quiz.question: White Revolution (Operation Flood) was led by:
quiz.explanation: Verghese Kurien led Operation Flood (White Revolution — milk), based on the Amul model

quiz.question: Golden Fibre Revolution is related to:
quiz.explanation: Golden Fibre Revolution relates to Jute production (Golden Revolution = fruits/honey; Fibre/White Fibre = cotton)

quiz.question: Round Revolution relates to:
quiz.explanation: Round Revolution relates to potato production (potatoes are round — easy trick)

quiz.question: Pink Revolution relates to:
quiz.explanation: Pink Revolution = Onion / Pharmaceuticals / Prawn (Red = Meat/Tomato; Silver = Eggs/Poultry; Golden = Fruits/Honey)

quiz.question: Rainbow Revolution means:
options: Integrated development of all agricultural sectors
quiz.explanation: Rainbow Revolution = integrated development of agriculture, horticulture, forestry, sugarcane, fishery, poultry and animal husbandry

quiz.question: Evergreen Revolution, coined by M.S. Swaminathan, means:
quiz.explanation: Evergreen Revolution = overall agriculture development in a sustainable manner without ecological harm
